nutrition.title: Nutrition
nutrition.vetAccess: You can see this because you have an appointment for this animal. Your changes are recorded.

off.title: Nutrition is not switched on yet
off.body: Food plans, feeding and body condition will appear here once the platform team turns this on. Nothing is lost in the meantime.

facts.title: A few more details make the plan better
facts.titleRequired: We need a few details first
facts.why: Saved once on the animal's profile, so every screen and the vet see the same answer.
facts.saved: Saved. The plan now uses these details.
facts.dateOfBirthHint: Not sure? Choose an approximate date.

body.bcsGuide9: 1 = very thin, 4-5 = ideal (ribs easy to feel, waist visible), 9 = very heavy.
body.empty: Nothing recorded yet. Add a weight to start the history.

plan.suggestedGoal: Suggested from the details: {{goal}}. Leave the goal empty to use it.
plan.targetWeightHint: Optional. Without it, the ideal weight is estimated from the body condition score.
plan.foodsEmpty: Add the foods you give. Search the list or add the one in your hand.
plan.kcalHint: Printed on the pack as kcal per 100 g (or kcal/kg divided by 10).
plan.needsKcal: Add the energy per 100 g to see how much to give.
plan.portion: {{perDay}} g a day · {{perMeal}} g a meal · {{kcal}} kcal
plan.sharesNote: The shares add up to {{total}}%. They are scaled to 100% for you.
plan.noFoodsFound: No food matches. Add it below.
plan.newFoodName: Food name as on the pack
plan.addOwnFood: Add a food that is not in the list
plan.requiresVet: Please ask a vet to check this plan - this animal's needs can differ a lot from the usual figures.
plan.unsafeFood: {{food}} is not safe for this animal. Remove it.
plan.markReviewed: I have reviewed this plan as the vet
plan.notYetTitle: Food calculator coming soon for this animal
plan.notYetBody: Meanwhile, track weight and body condition here, and use the safe-food guide. A vet can advise on feeding.
plan.noneBody: Make a plan: we work out how much of each food to give each day.
plan.needsFacts: Answer the questions above first - they are needed to work out the amounts.
plan.suggestedNote: Suggested - not yet vet-validated. A starting point: adjust with the weight trend, and ask a vet before big changes.
plan.reviewKcalHint: Change it only if this animal needs a different amount. The grams are worked out again.
plan.allergyFood: {{food}} - this animal is recorded as allergic to {{allergen}}. Remove it or ask the vet.
plan.pendingBody: This animal has {{conditions}} on its record, so a vet must check this plan before it replaces the one now in use. Keep feeding the current plan until then.

reasons.growing: Still growing - needs more energy for its size.
reasons.pregnant: Pregnant - needs change month by month; this is a starting point.
reasons.nursing: Nursing - needs can be much higher; this is a starting point.
reasons.underweight: Underweight - gaining should be planned with a vet.
reasons.overweight: Planned for slow weight loss, based on the ideal weight.
reasons.very_active: Very active or working - may need more; watch the weight.
reasons.low_activity: Low activity - planned on the lower side.
reasons.no_condition_score: Add a body condition score for a better estimate.
reasons.factor_unvalidated: Uses published figures not yet confirmed by the platform's vet.
reasons.needs_vet_amounts: A mother with young needs amounts set by a vet - ask for a feeding plan.

models.companion_energy: Food amounts are worked out from weight, age and activity.
models.ruminant_dm: Rations are worked out from the feeds you have.
models.monogastric_spec: Feed amounts for flocks and pig batches are worked out from the group's records.
models.aqua_biomass: Feed amounts for ponds are worked out from the pond's records and the water temperature.
models.equine_dm: Rations for horses and donkeys are worked out from the feeds you have - fodder first.
models.guidance_only: There is no checked feeding calculator for this kind of animal yet.

today.title: Today
today.noPlan: Make a food plan to see today's target.
today.guidanceOnly: Record what was fed to keep a history for the vet.
today.unsafeLogged: {{food}} can be harmful for this animal. If it ate a lot or seems unwell, call a vet now.
today.energyHint: Leave empty if you don't know - we work it out when the food has a known value.

bcs_high.title: Body condition is above ideal
bcs_high.next: Plan slow weight loss and keep treats small. Ask a vet if it keeps rising.

bcs_low.title: Body condition is below ideal
bcs_low.next: Ask a vet - being thin can be a sign of illness.

muscle_loss.title: Muscle loss noted
muscle_loss.next: Ask a vet to check - muscle loss can happen even when the weight looks normal.

rapid_weight_loss.title: Losing weight fast: about {{pctPerWeek}}% a week
rapid_weight_loss.next: Faster than is safe. Check the food amounts and ask a vet.

weight_drift.title: Weight changed by {{pct}}% while the goal is to keep it steady
weight_drift.next: Weigh again in a week. If it keeps changing, adjust the plan.

no_recent_weight.title: No weight in the last {{days}} days
no_recent_weight.next: Weigh now - plans work best with a recent weight.

treats_over_limit.title: Treats were {{pct}}% of the energy this week
treats_over_limit.next: Keep treats under 10% of the day's food.

unsafe_food_logged.title: Unsafe food given: {{food}} ({{date}})
unsafe_food_logged.next: If it ate a lot or seems unwell, call a vet now.

transition_condition_loss.title: Lost about {{drop5}} body condition point since giving birth ({{days}} days ago)
transition_condition_loss.next: Give more energy-rich feed and ask a vet - losing condition after giving birth can lead to ketosis and poor fertility.

feed_below_need.title: Fed {{pct}}% of the table amount this week ({{days}} days recorded)
feed_below_need.next: Check the feeder and the feed records. Feeding too little slows growth.

feed_above_need.title: Fed {{pct}}% of the table amount this week ({{days}} days recorded)
feed_above_need.next: Check for spilt or wasted feed - it raises FCR and cost.

safe.guidanceTitle: How to feed safely for now
safe.tipWeigh: Weigh regularly - every 2 to 4 weeks - and write it down here.
safe.tipCondition: Score body condition when you weigh.
safe.tipChange: Change foods slowly, over about a week.
safe.tipVet: Ask a vet what and how much to feed this kind of animal.
safe.title: Foods to keep away
safe.none: No foods are listed for this kind of animal yet. When in doubt, ask a vet.
safe.unvalidated: not yet confirmed by the platform's vet
safe.emergency: If your animal ate something harmful, call a vet straight away.

unsafe.copper_cattle_mix: Cattle mineral mixture or cattle feed (copper - fatal to sheep)

admin.title: Nutrition data
admin.subtitle: The reference data food plans are worked out from. Every row shows its source and whether a vet has confirmed it.
admin.offBody: Switch on nutrition.enabled in System settings to manage this data.
admin.speciesHelp: Which feeding model each species uses. A new species starts as guidance only.
admin.factorsHelp: Multiples of resting energy by life stage. A vet confirms each one by setting it to Vet-validated.
admin.name: Name
admin.unsafeHelp: Foods to keep away from a species. Matching words also warn when someone records feeding them.
admin.setsHelp: Nutrient minimums and maximums by species and life stage. Load a table only from a source you have the right to use.
admin.usageHelp: How nutrition is being used - for deciding later, from real use, whether to offer paid plans.
admin.noUsage: No use in this period yet.
admin.approveHelp: Approve every record still waiting, for use now. The vet can review them later.
admin.curvesHelp: Feed per bird or animal by age, and % of pond biomass by fish or shrimp size. Change a value to match your feed bag.
admin.noAlerts: No alerts yet in this period.
admin.alertQualityHelp: For each kind of alert: how many are open, and how people answered - "Seen" (right) or "Not right". The % is how often it was right.

ration.title: Ration for {{name}}
ration.milkHint: Today's yield. Saved on the animal's profile too. 0 for a dry animal.
ration.fatHint: From the dairy slip. Leave empty to use the usual value.

groups.fodder: Green fodder and straw you have
groups.concentrate: Concentrates and cattle feed you have
groups.fodderEquine: Hay and green grass you have
groups.concentrateEquine: Grain, gram and bran you have

ration.maxKg: Most you can give a day (optional)
ration.maxKgHint: For example, how much green fodder you have per animal.
ration.cannotBalance: These feeds cannot meet the need yet:

reasons.energy_too_low: Not enough energy - add grain, cattle feed or more green fodder.
reasons.protein_too_low: Not enough protein - add an oil cake (groundnut, cotton, mustard) or cattle feed.
reasons.minerals_missing: Minerals are short - add mineral mixture.
reasons.no_forage: Add green fodder or straw - the rumen needs it.
reasons.limits_too_tight: Your limits leave too little room - raise a "most you can give" limit.
reasons.grain_capped: Too little energy from fodder, and more grain would be unsafe - give better hay, lucerne or more green grass.

ration.needLine: Can eat {{dmMin}}-{{dmMax}} kg of dry feed a day; this ration gives {{dm}} kg.
ration.perDay: Dry feed without water: {{kg}} kg a day
ration.recordHint: Record what was fed each day in Daily records.
ration.noneBody: Tick the feeds you have and their prices - we find the cheapest mix that meets this animal's needs.
ration.workHint: Saved on the animal's profile too.
ration.avgWeightHint: From the weights recorded for the {{count}} animals. Change it if you know better - a weighing band estimate is fine.
ration.milkHerdHint: Average for the animals in milk. 0 for a dry herd.
ration.maxKgHead: Most you can give per animal a day (optional)

reasonsEquine.no_forage: Add hay or green grass - a horse's gut needs fodder first.
reasonsEquine.energy_too_low: Not enough energy - add oats, gram or bran, or better hay.
reasonsEquine.protein_too_low: Not enough protein - add horse gram, Bengal gram, lucerne or berseem.

ration.needLineEquine: Can eat {{dmMin}}-{{dmMax}} kg of dry feed a day; this ration gives {{dm}} kg, {{conc}}% of it grain.
ration.herdNoneBody: Tick the feeds you have - we find the cheapest mix for the herd's average animal and show the total for all {{count}}.
ration.herdEmpty: Add animals to this group first.
ration.herdRecordHint: Record the feed given in Daily records for this group.
ration.milkFromRecords: Using the last 7 days of milk records: {{litres}} L a day. Type a number to change it (0 = dry).
ration.growingNote: Still growing ({{months}} months old): fed for growth as well as upkeep, with more protein.
ration.firstLactationNote: First milking: still growing, so she gets extra energy.
ration.grainFeeds: Give the grain in {{count}} small feeds a day - one big feed of grain can cause colic.
ration.withdrawal: Medicine withdrawal: do not use the {{what}} until {{date}}.
ration.ageUnknown: No date of birth is recorded, so this is worked out for a grown animal. If it is a calf, kid or lamb, add its date of birth.

workDesc.moderate: Light work - an hour or two a day.
workDesc.high: Moderate work - several hours a day.
workDesc.working: Heavy work - full days (cart, plough, long rides).

ration.priceFromStock: Price from your stock: ₹{{price}} per kg. Change it in Feed Inventory.
ration.fromHerd: This animal is in the herd "{{name}}". Every animal in the herd gets this ration; change it on the herd.
ration.ownInstead: Make a ration for this animal only

group.title: Today's feed
group.noCurve: There is no feeding table for this kind of group yet. An admin can add one in Nutrition data.
group.biomass: {{count}} x {{g}} g = {{kg}} kg in the pond; {{rate}}% a day
group.temp: Water at {{c}} °C - feed {{pct}}% of the usual amount.
group.fcrNeedsWeights: Record sample weights in Daily records to see FCR.
group.fcrNeedsEggs: Record eggs in Daily records to see FCR.

needs.head_count: Record how many are in the group (place the batch or stock the pond).
needs.age: Start a cycle so the age of the batch is known.
needs.average_weight: Record a sample weight in Daily records.

group.priceFromStock: The cost shows once feed for this group is recorded from stock in Daily records.

vet.prescribeHelp: The plan becomes a prescription: the owner sees it with their prescriptions, and it can be printed like any other.

share.copied: Plan copied - paste it in WhatsApp or a message.
share.failed: Could not share from this phone. Take a screenshot instead.
share.gramsLine: {{perDay}} g a day ({{perMeal}} g a meal)

explain.aiNote: Written by AI from this plan's own numbers. The amounts above are the plan.
explain.builtInNote: A short summary of this plan.
explain.fallbackPet: This plan gives about {{kcal}} kcal a day in {{meals}} meals, worked out from the animal's weight, age and activity for the goal "{{goal}}". Weigh it every 2-4 weeks - the plan is adjusted from the weight trend.
explain.fallbackRation: This ration gives {{dm}} kg of dry matter a day for ₹{{cost}}. It is the cheapest mix of your feeds that meets the animal's need for energy, protein and minerals. Change the prices or feeds and it is worked out again.
